description: Interview for one job, then draft a resume from confirmed numbers only, in plain words, with any job and any AI agent. Your AI agent asks one question at a time about skills, strengths, and experience for one job description, checks every number with you, then drafts a one page resume for owner review. No invented numbers, no sent resume, draft only.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
